raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the release dates gathered by WebSurfer, swapping them—assigning Ekam: Son of Soil the 2006-09-24 date and Farber's Nerve the 2010-04-23 date—despite IMDb showing Ekam (2010-04-23) and Farber's Nerve (2006-09-24). This data inversion led to the incorrect conclusion that Ekam was released first instead of Farber's Nerve.
